rules.title: How to Play Fabble
rules.what_is_body: Fabble is a daily Flesh and Blood card deduction puzzle. Guess the secret card by comparing its attributes to your guesses — get closer with every try.
rules.making_a_guess_body: Type any real card name and submit it. You'll get feedback on 11 attributes of your guess compared to the answer.

legend.red_body: no match; an arrow means the answer's value is higher or lower.

columns.type: Type: the card's type (Hero, Weapon, Action, …).
columns.class: Class: the class(es) the card belongs to, if any.
columns.talent: Talent: the talent(s) the card belongs to, if any.
columns.pitch: Pitch: the pitch value(s) printed on the card.
columns.cost: Cost: the resource cost to play the card.
columns.power: Power: the card's printed power, if it has one.
columns.defense: Defense: the card's printed defense, if it has one.
columns.life: Life / Int: a Hero or Ally's life total.
columns.subtypes: Subtypes: the card's subtypes (Attack, Arrow, Trap, …).
columns.keywords: Keywords: functional keywords on the card (Go again, Dominate, …).
columns.set: Set: every set the card has been printed in.
